title: Document protected control-path routing
outcome: The autonomous-delivery protocol routes changes to .git, .codex, and .agents away from ordinary spawned implementers and to a trusted top-level maintenance context.
scope: Static workflow-contract coverage for protected control-path guidance
nonGoals: Changes to .git, .codex, .agents, agent definitions, skills, templates, Deno tasks, or application code

acceptanceCriteria.text: The delivery protocol identifies .git, .codex, and .agents as protected control paths for ordinary ticket work and routes required changes to a trusted top-level maintenance context, with a static contract test locking both statements.
acceptanceCriteria.redProof: deno test --allow-read tools/workflows/workflow_assets_test.ts fails only because the two protected-path statements are absent before the documentation change.

risks: Static documentation guidance could be mistaken for runtime sandbox enforcement
